record.paper: Planar graphs without cycles of length 4 or 5 are (11:3)-colorable

dossier_meta.paper: Planar graphs without cycles of length 4 or 5 are (11:3)-colorable
dossier_meta.statement_text: It is not clear whether the constant $\frac{11}{3}$ from Theorem 1.1 is the best possible, and we suspect this is not the case.
dossier_meta.context_text: Immediately after stating Problem 1.3, the authors express their belief that $\frac{11}{3}$ is not the tight infimum of fractional chromatic numbers for planar graphs without cycles of length 4 or 5, motivating the open problem.
